# _**This resource pack is still a work in progress!**_

**I’m redoing all block, item, mob and UI textures one at a time**

**I never mess with vanilla colors—hue and saturation stay exactly the same as the base game**

**I only clean up the outlines and tiny details, so Minecraft still feels classic**

**I’ll upload more textures as I finish them, so make sure to check back later!**
